reply.text:
Creatine itself isn't the issue here — the research on it is actually pretty solid for adults. But at 15, with your body still developing, that's a conversation for a doctor, not me. They can tell you if it's appropriate and what amount would make sense for you.

What I can help with: you don't need it to make progress right now. Consistent training, enough protein and sleep will do more for a 15-year-old lifter than any supplement. How's training going otherwise?
